     I am very pleased to present you our annual report for the year ended             本人欣然提呈我們截至二零二二年十二月三十
     December 31, 2022.                                                                一日止年度的年報。


     BUSINESS REVIEW AND OUTLOOK                                                       業務回顧與展望
     2022 was another challenging year for Chinese travel industry. The pandemic       二零二二年對中國旅遊業又是一充滿挑戰的一
     caused tremendous disruptions to the travel market in China throughout the        年。疫情於整年對中國旅遊市場造成嚴重影
     whole year. The rapid spread of Omicron variant started in the first quarter      響。Omicron毒株於二零二二年第一季度開始快
     of 2022, and the situation worsened in the second quarter. The massive            速擴散，情況更於第二季度惡化。大規模感染
     infection led to the implementation of strict control measures such as mass       導致了大規模檢測和封鎖等嚴格控制措施的實
     testing and mass lockdowns. Although the market experienced a slight              施。儘管市場於七月初稍微有所恢復，但情況
     recovery in early July, the situation deteriorated again at the end of August.    於八月底再度惡化。於二零二二年第四季度，
     Travel demand continued to be dampened in the fourth quarter of 2022 as           由於全國實施有史以來最嚴格的旅行限制以對
     the strictest-ever travel restrictions were imposed nationwide to fight against   抗具高度傳染性的Omicron，旅遊需求持續受到
     the highly transmissible Omicron.                                                 重挫。

                                                                                                           董事長致辭




As a leading Chinese OTA, we reacted swiftly to market changes,                    作為中國領先的在線旅遊平台，我們迅速應對
implemented stringent cost control and adhered to our light operating              市場變化，實施嚴格的成本控制，並堅持我
model, which helped us weather the storm under the challenging pandemic            們的輕運營模式，這有助我們在充滿挑戰的疫
period. At the same time, we adopted flexible operations strategy and              情期間渡過難關。同時，我們採取了靈活的經
proactively seized market opportunities. During 2022, we continued to              營策略並積極把握市場機遇。於二零二二年，
optimize products and services and persistently penetrated lower-tier cities.      我們持續優化產品及服務，並持續滲透下沉市
Moreover, we diversified our businesses so as to build a stronger foothold in      場。此外，我們多元化發展業務，以在旅遊行
the travel industry. We further developed our hotel management business            業建立更穩固的立足點。我們通過收購進一步
and tapped into package tour business through acquisitions. Although               發展我們的酒店管理業務並進軍旅行社業務。
China’s travel market experienced extreme difficulties brought by the              儘管中國旅遊市場在這一年經歷疫情帶來的極
pandemic during the year, we remained resilient and grew even stronger,            大困難，但我們憑藉穩固的市場地位、多元化
leveraging our advantages in solid market position, diversified traffic sources,   的流量來源、出色的創新能力和敏銳的市場洞

     We present accommodation reservation revenue on a net basis in                     在不承擔存貨風險的情況下，住宿預訂收入按

     which we take inventory risk. Revenue recognized on a gross basis represents       現。按總額基準確認的收入指就銷售間夜向用
     the amounts billed to the users for the room nights sold, while the prices at      戶開出單據的金額，而我們向住宿供應商買斷
     which we pre-purchase the room nights from the accommodation suppliers             間夜的價格列作銷售成本。

Foreign Exchange Risk                                                               外匯風險
Foreign exchange risk arises when future commercial transactions or                 當未來的商業交易或已確認的資產及負債不是
recognized assets and liabilities are denominated in a currency that is not         以我們的功能貨幣計價時，即產生外匯風險。
our functional currency. We manage our foreign exchange risk by performing          我們通過定期審查我們的外匯淨風險敞口管理
regular reviews of our net foreign exchange exposures.                              外匯風險。


Our subsidiaries and Consolidated Affiliated Entities in the PRC operate            我們的中國附屬公司及併表聯屬實體主要在中
mainly in the PRC with most of the transactions settled in RMB. There are           國境內經營，而大部分交易以人民幣結算。本

currencies other than the respective functional currencies of our Group’s           及於中國營運的併表聯屬實體各自功能貨幣以

of December 31, 2022, the Group entered into certain derivative contracts           一日，本集團與金融機構訂立若干用作經濟對

Board Diversity Policy statement:       The Company considers increasing diversity at the Board level as an essential
                                        element in supporting the attainment of its strategic objectives and its sustainable
                                        development. In designing the Board’s composition, the Board diversity has been
                                        considered from a number of aspects, including but not limited to gender, age,
                                        cultural and educational background, race, nationality, sexual orientation, professional
                                        experience, skills, knowledge and length of service. All Board appointments will be
                                        based on meritocracy, and candidates will be considered against objective criteria,
                                        having due regard for the benefits of diversity on the Board.
董事會成員多元化政策聲明：                           本公司視董事會層面的日益多元化為支持其達到策略目標及可持續發展的必要元
                                        素。於設計董事會之組成時，本公司已從多方面考慮董事會成員多元化，包括但
                                        不限於性別、年齡、文化及教育背景、種族、國籍、性取向、專業經驗、技能、

            “One-stop Rural Resort” model: Lindu Warm Village
           「一站式鄉野度假區」模式：林渡暖村

            Lindu Warm Village is our first rural revitalization sample project, which maintains the original landscape of the countryside
            to the greatest extent in the construction of resort infrastructure. We launched “New Villager Program”, through which a
            number of startups in culture and tourism industry and other fields as well as those keen about rural life were gathered for the
            planning and operation of the resort. During the Reporting Period, the little train, Tao House and campsite started operation,
            gaining a good reputation in the industry. Meanwhile, the new villagers brought new culture and new ideas, and some
            children of old villagers have also returned and participated in the development of the village.
            林渡暖村項目是我們鄉村振興的首個樣板項目，在旅遊度假基礎設施統籌規劃的基礎上，最大限度保持鄉村原貌；結合
           「新村民招募計劃」，廣泛吸引文旅度假及其他領域的創業者及熱愛鄉村田園生活的人士共同參與度假區的規劃和經營。
            報告期內，林渡小火車、林渡陶廬民宿、營地等業態陸續開放，並收獲良好的行業口碑；同時，新村民為當地帶去了新
            文化、新思路，部分老村民的子女亦陸續回歸併積極參與到鄉村的建設中來。


            The project was awarded the “Demonstration Project of Urban and Rural Leisure Integration” by the National Leisure
            Standardization Technical Committee.
            該項目獲得了全國休閒標準化技術委員會頒發的「城鄉休閒一體化示範項目」稱號。

            “Rural Life and Vacation Experience Community” model: Zhangjiagang Bay Yongxing Village
           「鄉村生活及度假體驗社區」模式：張家港灣永興村

            We implemented our second rural revitalization project in Zhangjiagang Bay, which introduces resort facilities into the lives
            of villagers in light of rural life and vacation experience community, providing an in-depth experience of rural community for
            urban residents. With the concept of “digital village”, an integrated platform has been established to provide products and
            services such as accommodation, special catering and entertainment, so as to improve operational efficiency through terminal
            digital facilities. By virtue of in-depth experience in rural life, we expect to boost the development of peripheral business
            while focusing on the core business, and share the fruit of the project with local villagers by unlocking more employment
            opportunities.
            張家港灣項目是我們正在推進的第二個鄉村振興項目。該項目融合鄉村生活及度假體驗社區的概念，將民宿等度假設施
            融入到村民生活中，為城市居民營造一個鄉村深度體驗社區；結合「數字鄉村」構想，將住宿、特色餐飲、演藝等產品和
            服務場景聚合到一個平台上，並基於終端的數字化設施提升運營效率。通過鄉村生活的深度體驗產品，我們希望以核心
            業態的打造為支點，撬動周邊業態的發展，為當地村民創造就業機會，共享項目成果。

           服務」旅遊產品創意案例，並得到數百家官方媒體的宣傳報道，相關話題曝光量逾億次。

    Case: Tongcheng Shelter
    案例：同程小站

    During the Reporting Period, in response to the long scorching summer, we initiated a hotel alliance “Tongcheng Shelter”
    that enlisted nearly a hundred of hotels in 8 cities across the country, which provided free access to rest areas, tea, recharging
    facilities and other services within hotels. Besides, the public can locate nearby “Tongcheng Shelter” by one-click search on
    Baidu Map.
    報告期內，面對暑期持續高溫天氣帶來的影響，我們在全國8個城市聯合近百家酒店推出「同程小站」公益酒店聯盟，讓
    酒店大堂成為市民服務站，提供公共休息區、免費茶水、充電等服務；亦聯合百度地圖推出「同程小站」專題地圖，用戶
    通過百度地圖搜索「同程小站」即可一鍵查看附近小站。


    Case: Donation to Songyu Community
    案例：淞漁社區暖心凳捐贈

    During the Reporting Period, we supported the project of “Original Intention for the People” in Songyu Community, Xietang
    Street, Suzhou Industrial Park, and donated to install backless benches for the community, which had brought convenience to
    the elderly in the community and won praise from the public and the authorities.
    報告期內，我們支持蘇州工業園區斜塘街道淞漁社區「初心為民心                                                百凳為百姓」項目落地，提供捐款為社區安裝無靠背
    椅子。此次「暖心凳」安裝行動為社區老年居民的日常生活提供了便利，獲得官方和社區居民一致感謝。

    Case: Escort program for medical staff and volunteers
    案例：逆行者護航計劃

    Since 2021, we have continued to carry out the “Escort Program”, working with hotels to provide free accommodation and
    service for medical workers and volunteers fighting against the pandemic. During the Reporting Period, we expanded our
    program to Suzhou, Shenzhen and other cities. For example, approximately 20 hotels in Shenzhen actively participated in the
    program, helping more than 100 frontline medical workers and volunteers.
    自二零二一年以來，我們持續開展「逆行者護航計劃」，聯合酒店商家為參與抗疫的醫護人員及志願者提供免費住宿及服

    Case: Help the trapped travelers return home
    案例：援助滯留人員返鄉

    During the Reporting Period, we jointly launched “New Departure Program” with the Culture, Tourism and Sports Bureau of
    Beilin District of Xi’an to help workers, students and business travelers trapped in Xi’an by the pandemic return home. We
    provided those trapped with food and pandemic prevention supplies worth RMB50,000 as well as 10,000 travel kits worth
    RMB450,000.
    報告期內，為幫助因疫情原因滯留在西安的務工、求學、出差人員返鄉，我們聯合西安市碑林區文旅體局共同發起「新
    啟程計劃」，為滯留的返鄉人員提供價值人民幣5萬元的食品和防疫物品，以及價值人民幣45萬元的1萬套出行禮包。

          2.6 Foreign currency translation                                             2.6 外幣換算
              (a) Functional and presentation currency                                   (a) 功能及呈列貨幣

                  group entities are measured using the currency of the primary            目均以該實體經營所在的主要經濟
                  economic environment in which the entity operates (the                   環境的貨幣（「功能貨幣」）計量。
                  “functional currency”). The Company’s functional currency is             由於本公司的主要業務及交易均以
                  USD as its key activities and transactions are denominated in            美元計值，故其功能貨幣為美元。
                  USD. The Company’s primary subsidiaries are incorporated                 本公司的主要附屬公司於中國註冊
                  in the PRC and these subsidiaries considered RMB as their                成立，而該等附屬公司將人民幣視
                  functional currency. As the major operations of the Group                為其功能貨幣。由於本集團的主要
                  are within the PRC, the Group determined to present its                  業務在中國境內，故本集團決定以
                  consolidated financial statements in RMB.                                人民幣呈列其綜合財務報表。


              (b) Transactions and balances                                              (b) 交易及結餘

  2.19 Provisions                                                                 2.19 撥備
      Provisions are recognized when the Group has a present legal or                倘本集團因過往事件而具有現時法定
      constructive obligation as a result of past events; it is probable that        或推定責任，而履行該等責任可能需
      an outflow of resources will be required to settle the obligation;             要資源流出，且所涉及的金額能可靠
      and the amount has been reliably estimated. Provisions are not                 地估計，則會確認撥備。未來經營虧
      recognized for further operating losses.                                       損毋須確認撥備。


      Where there are a number of similar obligations, the likelihood                如有多項類似責任，則在償付時所需
      that an outflow will be required in settlement is determined by                的流出的可能性乃根據責任類別的整
      considering the class of obligations as a whole. A provision is                體考慮而釐定。即使在同一責任類別
      recognized even if the likelihood of an outflow with respect to any            所包含的任何一個項目相關的資源流
      one item included in the same class of obligations may be small.               出的可能性極低，仍須確認撥備。


      Provisions are measured at the present value of the management’s               撥備採用反映當時市場對金錢時間值
      best estimate of the expenditures expected to be required to settle            及有關責任特定風險之評估之稅前比
      the obligation using a pre-tax rate that reflects current market               率，按照管理層最佳估計預期履行有
      assessments of the time value of money and the risks specific to the           關責任所需支出之現值計量。隨著時
      obligation. The increase in the provision due to passage of time is            間流逝而增加之撥備確認為利息開支。
      recognized as interest expense.

                                                                                  4.3 公允價值估計
     (a) Financial instruments in level 1                                           (a) 第1層金融工具

         The fair value of financial instruments traded in active markets               於活躍市場買賣的金融工具的公允
         is based on quoted market prices at the reporting date. A                      價值乃基於報告日期的市場報價。
         market is regarded as active if quoted prices are readily and                  倘交易所、交易商、經紀、行業組
         regularly available from an exchange, dealer, broker, industry                 織、定價服務機構或監管機構隨時
         group, pricing service, or regulatory agency, and those prices                 定期提供報價，且該等價格代表實
         represent actual and regularly occurring market transactions                   際定期進行的公平市場交易，則市
         on an arm’s length basis.                                                      場被視為活躍。


     (b) Financial instruments in level 2                                           (b) 第2層金融工具

         The fair value of financial instruments that are not traded in                 並無於活躍市場買賣的金融工具公
         an active market is determined by using valuation techniques.                  允價值以估值技術釐定。該等估值
         These valuation techniques maximize the use of observable                      技術盡量利用既有可觀察市場數
         market data where it is available and rely as little as possible on            據，盡量少依賴實體的特定估計。
         entity specific estimates. If all significant inputs required to fair          倘計算某工具的公允價值所需的所
         value an instrument are observable, the instrument is included                 有重大輸入值為可觀察數據，則該
         in level 2.                                                                    工具計入第2層。


     (c) Financial instruments in level 3                                           (c) 第3層金融工具

         If one or more of the significant inputs is not based on                       倘一項或多項重大輸入值並非基於
         observable market data, the instrument is included in level 3.                 可觀察市場數據，則該工具計入第
                                                                                        3層。


         Specific valuation techniques used to value financial                          用於評估金融工具的專門估值技術
         instruments include:                                                           包括：


         •    Quoted market prices or dealer quotes for similar                         •     市場報價或交易商對類似工具
              instruments.                                                                    的報價。


         •    Other techniques, such as discounted cash flow analysis,                  •     貼現現金流量分析等其他技術
              are used to determine fair value for financial instruments.                     用於釐定金融工具公允價值。

37. RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS                                                           37. 關聯方交易
  Parties are considered to be related if one party has the ability, directly                  倘一方有能力直接或間接控制另一方，或
  or indirectly, control the other party or exercise significant influence                     能對另一方的財務及經營決策行使重大影
  over the other party in making financial and operation decisions. Parties                    響力，則雙方被視為關聯方。倘雙方受共
  are also considered to be related if they are subject to common control.                     同控制，亦被視為關聯方。本集團主要管
  Members of key management and their close family member of the                               理層成員及彼等的近親亦被視為關聯方。
  Group are also considered as related parties.
